target_customer: Wealth advisors and RIA firms, mostly mid-sized, that build sales proposals for prospects
problem: Advisors spend hours reading brokerage, tax and estate documents and building personalized proposals for prospective clients.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to RIAs (pricing not found)
product_category: AI document analysis and proposal generation for wealth management

founders.name: Kanishk Parashar
prior_employers: RCI Navigator (co-founder, acquired by Addepar in January 2021)

founders.name: Soo Yung Cho
prior_employers: RCI Navigator (founding team, acquired by Addepar 2021)
education: Johns Hopkins University, BS computer science

founders.name: David Goerz
prior_employers: Institutional asset owner portfolio management, 33 years (employers not named on YC page)

founders.name: Dominic Tully
founders.role: Co-founder, Head of Sales and Operations

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing messy brokerage, tax and estate documents with LLMs needs accuracy, hallucination checks and portfolio analytics; standard but demanding.

defensibility.rationale: Founders' Addepar network and accuracy tuning help, but Feathery, Farther and others later built proposal tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Wealth platforms and startups (Farther, Feathery) launched AI proposal tools after Powder's launch; no acquisition of Powder found.

market_need_then: Advisors rely on manual proposal work; Powder launched at the T3 conference in January 2024 with 20 mid-sized RIA clients per trade press.

branding.domain_note: Uses powderfi.com with fi suffix rather than powder.com.
branding.community_and_virality: Trade press coverage (WealthManagement, March 2024 'generative AI co-analyst'), no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Coverage was about the product, not the brand; the name is generic and shared with unrelated businesses.

outcome_analysis: Powder is active and raised a 5 million dollar seed announced July 2024, about six months after launch, with YC and General Catalyst among about 40 investors. The founding team came from RCI Navigator, which Addepar bought in 2021, giving domain access and sales credibility. Rivals later entered proposal automation, and no later round was found, so it remains early with unproven scale.
notes: Seed is reported by WealthManagement and several outlets; aggregators conflict on totals (CB Insights 5.5M, one site 500K). The AI Insider says YC and General Catalyst, matching WealthManagement. No dated competitor sources near January 2024 found; the trade press cites Benjamin (shut down 2021) only as an earlier attempt. Education for Parashar, Goerz and Tully not listed on YC page. Powder markets 'over 13 billion in proposals generated' (company claim via press).
